notes.title: Cardboard Town v1.4.0 - Booster Packs Update
notes.content:
Hi Mayors!

With this Major Free Update we are adding to the game:
- New System: Booster Packs
- 4 Booster Packs
- 2 New Buildings
- 2 New Action Cards

With this update, we are introducing Booster Packs which will let you choose a category and create cards from that category in your hand.

Booster Packs

"Available at all times" way to get these Booster Packs is via Star Quests.
Now whenever you complete a Star Quest, you'll be presented with 3 Booster Pack options.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/1bdd9f1a71c07c262e288f1e077a0fb6febb5cb0.png

The Booster Packs are:
- Housing Booster: Gain 3 Random Population Buildings
- Essentials Booster: 1 Water, 1 Electricity, 1 Random Resource Building
- Action Booster: 3 Random Action Cards
- Luxury Booster: 3 Buildings that cost 7 or more.

If you like the concept, we can add more booster packs in the future, so make sure to let us know!

New Cards

Booster Pack Factory
Spend a lot of resources to gain a Booster Pack!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/07686c318375f68adfc39dd4e64becdfe2bb78af.png


Memorial Park
Destroy a random card from your hand and gain some environment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/a9ab45805b625e37e689f19672a9fac335e476ed.png

Resealing:
Destroy 3 Cards. Get a Random Booster Pack.

Unhinged Training:
Destroy your hand. Get 2 random Booster Packs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/3f0b1bb49190c2d2dfe7f5aaa6f2979c0d8bbc44.png

Hope this update will both give you more control over your playstyle with the choices of your booster pack and will still keep it fresh since packs are full of surprises!

Enjoy the update and have fun building away, Mayors!

[previewyoutube=g5Z7QTFEWlc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Celebrating 100,000 Downloads with a New Update!
notes.content:
Hey Mayors,

Thank you so much for 100,000 Downloads! 

We keep saying we are done updating the game and it's complete, but your love keeps making us come back and we have a new update on the way for you!

Before we jump into that, we'd also like to announce Cardboard Town is joining Steam City Builders & Colony Sim Fest with our deepest discount!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/4f4f4c1441bd3bb57c2380dff386219085d6e164.png

And talking about city builders, in case you missed them, just letting you know that we have a lot of them:
Stellar Settlers - A Space Colony Builder 
Mini City: Mayhem - A hectic, cute town builder
Hexaroma - Chill village builder
Kingdom's Deck - An upcoming deck / castle builder

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/740193d0cf8a49868cba63099c5f8ba007520203.png
You can get them as a bundle and save, don't forget to wait for the festival to start for a better discount!

Booster Pack Update is on the Way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/1bdd9f1a71c07c262e288f1e077a0fb6febb5cb0.png

Our next (and maybe really final this time?) update is called The Booster Pack Update. We are working on it to release as a free update on June 8th, 2025.

Upon completing Star Quests in a run, you'll be able to choose a booster pack that - obviously - includes some random cards in a theme.

Examples:
Housing Pack: Get 3 random population buildings.
Essentials Pack: Get 3 basic resource buildings.
Luxury Pack: Get 2 buildings that cost $7 or more.

This will give you some control on what type of cards you want to add to your hand while keeping the fun randomness of Cardboard Town.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/3f0b1bb49190c2d2dfe7f5aaa6f2979c0d8bbc44.png

Other Ways To Get Booster Packs in a Run:
We'll have some new action cards that generate booster packs. However, to combat deck bloat, those cards will need you to destroy some existing cards first!

Remember that Discard and Destroy are different mechanics and destroying a card permanently removes that card from that run (but of course you find / obtain that same card again later on) 

Resealing: Destroy 3 Cards. Get a random booster pack.

Unhinged Trading: Destroy all cards in your hand. Get 2 random booster packs.


A New Building:
We've talked about how you can't open booster backs freely with too many cars in hand, so we have a new building to help you get rid of a card to make some room.

Memorial Park: Destroy a card to play, gain some Environment.

We are also planning on a Booster Pack Factory building which needs a lot of resources but generate you a booster pack. 

That's mostly it for the June 8th Booster Pack Update, do you like it? Do you have ideas? Do you want anything else? Please do let us know and maybe we can make it happen!!

Thanks for reading Mayors, see you on the festival!

notes.title: v1.3.2 - New Cards Against Deck Bloat
notes.content:
You thought days of update for Cardboard Town are over? Well, we thought so too.

After we've parted ways with the game's artist and tired from developing the game from all these months, we wanted to focus on our newer titles.

But as we had the chance to take a little break from Cardboard Town and studying the style of the game with our new team members, we've wanted to add some new stuff to make the game even better!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/911d25d639fd95c9ae87e28377945d7586f8f29f.png


Cards Against Deck Bloat

To have a functioning city, you need many different cards. But many cards means you have less control over your deck. We've heard your feedback on this and thought it would be a good idea to fight this with even more cards.

Jokes aside, our 2 new buildings (which are in the Starting Deck now) let you destroy some cards, so you can get rid of ones that you don't want in your deck.

Asphalt Factory
It's a cheap building that lets you have some pocket money in terms of Tax Dollars (this lets you go over your maximum money, so it helps fight the RNG with drawing expensive cards early) and with Turn to Gravel you can Destroy a Card to generate a one-time-use road.

So while this building generates 2 cards, both of them are destroyed upon use and one of them even lets you destroy any card you don't want in your hand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/f1007ade3311e6e280af2716419b66084a243d73.png

Waste Management Facility
This building (also in the Starting Deck) generates an Action card called Decompose, which you can use to destroy a card to gain some resources. 

Having two cheap buildings that let you destroy cards will let you get rid of cards that you don't want in your deck and hopefully combat the deck bloat issues!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/eff7c9f31d8db967d9a76a57b2d2631b4d91d011.png

99 Problems but a Resource ain't one

Now you can effectively remove a resource from a run! Stabilizing a resource will mean it will be locked in place, it will no longer trigger with effects and can not be reduced or increased.

Don't want to care about your people's safety? Then don't!

But of course this is a very powerful effect, so it's not easy to come by. You need to find the Resource Fusion Center first from one of your 'get a new card' events. Then, you need to place that building to get a random resource Stabilizer added to your deck. 

When you draw that stabilizer, if you don't like the resource it stabilizes, fret not! Just discard it to get a new one. 

While this is a neat new feature, as with all things new, it might cause bugs. So if you encounter one, please do let us know! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/ea96f0ead45b9ace82d5caf4fca28d2097e4e8d1.png

Two More Things...

Finally, we have another fun building for you; R&D Facility.
This building creastes a Tax Dollar and a Random Action Card for all you excitement seekers out there!

Also we have a new action card that can be found during runs called Fruits of Science, which gives you one of each resource. Nice!

With more deck control cards in the starting deck and our new mechanics, we hope you'll enjoy the new version of Cardboard Town!


New City Builder Game Coming Up!
We also have a new city building game in the works! It's less card focused and more shape focused, a cute little game where you can stack buildings on top of each other. If you want to check it out, do it so here:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/246d20a5318720ffda96cc9fa009d6947c4ece3c.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2517440/Mini_City_Mayhem/

Mini City Mayhem on Steam [DEMO AVAILABLE]

You can let us know in Discord if you have any feedback.
Have fun, Mayors!

notes.title: v1.3 - Tourism Update!
notes.content:
Hello Mayors,

Our team was hard at work and so our biggest and final content update is finally here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/0107cc5f5c4cec29e6069434b18005dac809d766.png

We have;
- New Resource (Tourism)
- Custom Game Mode
- New Buildings
- New Festivals
- New Disasters
- Balance Changes
- Initial Deck Management Improvements
- Star Quest Changes
- Translation Improvement
- A New Ending!

How does Tourism work?
It is our third Bonus Resource after Industry and Education and it usually increases via expensive buildings like Casinos and decreases whenever a disaster happens.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/f941c627a16824369fd45287350a5df29acba2a1.png

Tourism is mostly about Money management (sell your resources to go above your maximum Money or play action cards that leverage long term effects) and Safety management as you need to keep disasters away to keep your City tour-able!

Office Buildings for Bonus Resources
To improve your chances of managing an extra resource that you've unlocked, now you get an Office Building for that specific resource.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/c12b7fce5240c2fd7480802ffdad9e5797b39ce1.png

This building creates a random, resource related card, giving you more options than your initial unlocks. Make sure to place them and get your new cards!

Custom Mode is Here
Choose your own parameters and play on your own rules! You can change base rules of the game such as; Red Alert Count, Map Size, Starting Money, Trouble-Meter length...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/6b61271b0a94e776b0db4372ddb069567f3fde63.png

You won't be gaining Votes on this mode for Meta-Progression (of course) but you can create your own challenges for fun!

More Deck Control
We've heard that you want more control over your Starting Deck.
Now, through Days 4-5-6-7, you'll be able to "choose 1 of 3 cards" from Water - Electricty - Safety - Environment resources, in that order.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/e9ef2d69faeb7ec2af4f362fa9cc50e2172e6361.png

We've also added an Action Card to the initial deck that destroys other cards, so you can get rid of even more cards that you no longer use.

With these additions, now in Cardobard Town; 
- You get to choose 7 Cards in the first 7 Days of the game
- Have access to consistent Card removal
- Modify your deck further via in-game events

While we know it's not a complete deck-builder feature; Cardboard Town is not primarly a deck-builder but rather a city-building game with cards. So we hope this will satisfy your deck-building feeling needs a little!


Star Quest Reworks
Since now we have three different Bonus Resources, it's time to pick a card! 
Instead of giving you a random Resource Quest Card, at the end of 3-Star Quest you get to choose the card yourself. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/c6b6df9959f6206a8d30d4d7c52a152528a8d854.png

Also;
- We've removed "have N resources above X" quests from the 4-Star Quest pool. These still exist in lower Stars, but the fourth tier was really taxing so we've swapped it with "Reach 400 Population"

- 5-Star Quest Population Requirement 600 -> 500 to let you help finish the game faster.


Balance Changes
It's not a real patch if we didn't make the game a little easier. Ah, you should've seen the earlier days when no one was able to finish the game... But as we grow more popular, we have to adjust to non-genre people as well and keep challenging aspects in our Game Modes.

- Founders Festival now gives an additional Festival at the end of it, instead of a Disaster.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/a614be1cd95297a8697c03fe9e0bb4e0c1cdc19e.png

- All Disasters in the game now last shorter.
- Starting Deck reduced by 2 Cards (-1 House, -1 Clinic)


As our team members are sailing away to new adventures and we feel we've improved the game to a stable and satisfying version, we're not planning any major content updates in the future. 

Thank you so much for supporting Cardboard Town for over a year and we hope you've liked all the updates and content we've added to the game over this this period, from new cards to features such as the Leader-board.

Good luck and have fun discovering the new cards!

notes.title: v1.2.5 - New Card is Here & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello there, we're with you with a small but important update!

New card: Wish Upon A Star

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/aea8f9b5de84f0f77f98b0be391e1d33d9ce72a7.png

This card enables you to reroll your Star Quest. 

Sometimes players were unhappy with the quests they received and "didn't want to go that way" and in extreme cases; game could get stuck (E.g; Quest wants you to play 5 Cards in a day but you've got the Going Slow upgrade, limiting your daily cards to 3)

With the Wish Upon A Star card, you can either immediately reroll the first quest that you get or hold on to it strategically.

New Disaster: Communist Strike 
Who doesn't love a new disaster, right? R-right?
Anyway, a new disaster is probably better then an old disaster. As Sana have said recently; "Gimme that New New!" so we're giving you the New New.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/aeb13c677de5936e7e6275df5c6acbcb0535ea39.png

So what does the disaster do?
Communist Strike: At the start of your day; Discard your most expensive card, draw a new card, lose 1 Money.

It's not very annoying as it has a very high chance to discard a card that you couldn't play yet anyway, but it is annoying as it hurts your long-term plans and costs you money. So we believe it's a balanced disaster for early game.

Fixed Bugs:
- Industrial Furnace was generating the wrong card
- Minor bug behind the Red Alert system 
- An Upgrade was causing the Mega-Project cards to be destroyed
- Minor bug in an interaction between an upgrade and a disaster
- Fixed a visual bug related to "Going Slow" upgrade.

Big, Big Update on the way!

"Hey, this update is so small, booo!" you might be saying, please don't :(

Because we are working on a really cool update. We don't want to spoil anything yet, but it includes;
- New resource!
- New End-game
- New buildings
- New cards
- Custom Mode
- and more.


Check out our New games! 
Some of our team members are working on new titles. If you like Cardboard Town, you might like these too! So we'd be glad if you check out Stellar Settlers and even more glad if you wish-list it! It's being designed by Cardboard Town's Co-Producer, Burak Tokak.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2628570/Stellar_Settlers_Space_Base_Builder/

You can also check out Rogue Duck Interactive on Steam , the new video game company of Cardboard Town's co-producer & game designer, Dora Özsoy.

--

Thanks for reading and happy mayoring!

notes.title: v1.2.0 - Sandbox Mode & Other Mode Updates
notes.content:
Okay, okay, we've heard you! Sandbox mode is here!

You don't want to worry about red alerts, resources, or even just READING THE CARDS and that's... okay i guess. 

Go ahead and build whatever you want!

Introducing Sandbox Mode

Build your dream Town made out of Cardboard in this mode without any hassle!
For a short while, we've made Sandbox Mode available for everybody to test it out.

In this mode; you'll be able to draw any road or building card you want and use it without any money or resource requirement!

In the original version it will be unlocked on Mayor Level 16, which does not take long to reach to, especially in standard modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/1c77c7d2bf127429f9e58923085c0e3179e62124.png

Sandbox mode screenshots already started to come in! If you give it a try, share your screenshots with us on Twitter @strateragames

Unlocking New Modes - System Change

In the previous version, this is how the modes were unlocked:
- Mayor Level: 2 Modes 
- Rocket Ending: 3 Modes 
- Drill Ending: 3 Modes 

We've noticed it's too much for casual players, so we've moved most of the "ending" modes to the Mayor Level meta progression instead.


 Level 4:  Blessed Town Unlocked
 Level 13:  Towntanic Unlocked
 Level 16:  Sandox Mode Unlocked
 Level 20:  Cursed Unlocked (as before)
 Level 29:  Rural Town Unlocked
 Level 41: Democratic Town Unlocked
 Level 51: Utopia Unlocked (as before)
 When you finish the game with Rocket Ending: Quick Decisions Unlocked
 When you finish the game with Drill Ending: Expanding Town Unlocked


Lowering the Vote Count for Max Level
It used to require 23,500 Votes to reach Mayor Level 60, we're reducing this to 20,000.
Please let us know how do you feel about meta progression speed and feel so we can adjust it better!

Other Updates & Changelog

 Synchronized card data across platforms.
 Implemented save feature in sandbox mode.
 Unlocked sandbox mode for testing purposes.
 Modified end-game scenarios for diverse gameplay.
 Major UI enhancements for improved user experience.
 Introduced sandbox mode for creative play.
 Fixed main menu navigation issues.
 Implemented new deck rules for balanced gameplay.
 Improved gamepad navigation in card library.
 Enhanced performance and stability of Sandbox asset.
 Added gamepad support in sandbox mode (work in progress).
 General game improvements and optimizations.
 Resolved duplicate quest card issue.
 Updated booster pack illustrations for a fresh look.

notes.title: v1.1.0 - Goodbye Troubles, Hello Crisis Cards & POV Mode!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

You said more control, less RNG, we listened! 

Let's start by celebrating the update with a 40% Discount starting November 14th 10 AM PST until the end of the Steam Autumn Sale!

We have a few headlines today so let's get right into the case:

Goodbye, Troubles!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/93dde2aede05a3a15fac28426cbc40cdafde1c63.gif

We know how much you hate the troubles (those small disturbances that happen on 3rd turn of the Trouble-Meter) and annoyance it brings.

Troubles were here to;
- Provide challenge to players
- Make sure resetting / reducing the Trouble-Meter had to be done with care
- Add a fun randomness to the game

However, they had too much emphasis for being such a small disturbance.
E.g; You had to look out when you were building a Police Station just to avoid a -1 hit to your Envirorment score, which doesn't feel very nice. Or you'd get a notification every couple of turns, which could be annoying / distracting.

Things like that. But we've kept the mechanic despite all that because of the reasons above, until we've decided that it's just not worth it anymore.

But we still want to keep some positive parts of it, so it's time to say;

Hello, Crisis Cards

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/c049db853274bb70e47fb997887ad4170e2ce06e.png

Crisis Cards always have negative sides; but they usually also have positive parts too and it's up to you to whether to play them or just ignore them! 

For example, the trouble "Yet Another Oil Leak" would make you lose -1 Environment randomly.
The card "Yet Another Oil Leak" still makes you lose -1 Environment but;
- You decide when that happens
- You get a Coin in return.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/8c09f1f43fc3f55891159845151778ced3f0e8ae.png

Crisis Cards can not be destroyed, but they can be discarded. So you can choose to deal with them later, but if you ignore them for too long, they will bloat your deck.

Currently, crisis cards come at every 100th Population but we may change that number, or change to mechanic's trigger point later, according to balance. As always, we're open to ideas and feedback!

PoV Mode

No one asked for this, but it's here!
You can now press ALT key to switch to miniature-view and experience your city first hand!

It will also trigger itself after 5 minutes of inactivity, like your lil' screen saver.

Other Stuff

Controller Support: Cardboard town now has full controller support for Xbox & Steam Deck controllers. (Dualshock is supported but the interface is still in progress for it) This feature still experimental, please share your experiences and ideas in Steam Discussion Forum.

Cloud Save: Now we have cross-platform Steam Cloud Save support, which means, your game save will not be lost even if you remove the local game data, or if you want to keep playing your level on another device.

Linux & Steam OS Support: Cardboard Town now is ported and works stably on Linux and Steam OS devices natively.

Notarized MacOS support (Silicon): Cardboard Town binary on MacOS now works more efficiently and the game binary is notarized via AppStore.

On-going work for Mobile: We keep on working on porting our game for iOS and Android. We will have more information in the coming releases.

1.1 Announcement Trailer

You don't like reading? We got you, here is our 1.1 Trailer video;

[previewyoutube=W8Xtf-Geb6Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: v1.0.8 - Quality of Life & Balance Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/22ab2c9e725fdbf607bb47a5c629d94f64e95355.pngSteam Trading Cards & More

Cardboard Town is now eligible for Trading cards! 
Keep playing the game to drop Trading Cards! Collect them all to get badges, emojis and profile backgrounds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/0b18ad071dfd892e997c2bcddb8b0c85a804ded8.png

Gameplay Updates

Fire-Fighting card was available since the first build, fire itself however... Was problematic and never available in the main version. Well, no more; it's time to burn down the city!! 🔥🔥

Try to take care of the fire early on or it might spread. It doesn't destroy buildings; but each active fire has a chance to burn down your resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/21400cb02981c3a87ace2f6cce5699eae7d959b4.gif

QoL Updates
Now when you hit all Red-Alerts; instead of an instant game-over; you get a final warning and lose the game only if you end the game with all Red-Alerts lit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/1f6955e756e06b080909dbb2d23d196b1054ed10.gif

When you hover a card, it shows the building tile size, so you can pick which building to place with all the information at your disposal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/2a7d9497d0c7a4cfa779c45fcde3846a9d8ef2b4.gif

We saw that sometimes players try to drag and drop the cards on the board (like Hearthstone) we wanted to allow this behavior, now you can drag and drop a building card on the board and it gets built! 
Same goes for action cards, you can just drag and drop them to play!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/69d5e9d0f85eee266b16ea5792931b7f8758bc7e.gif

Sometimes, for any reason, a card might not be playable. Normally; an alert sound plays and if there's a disaster preventing the card from being played, the disaster shakes. However when there's no disaster and you just don't have the money: not enough visual feedback occurs. So now when you try to play a card that you are not able to play: it shakes! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/ab5d39d9a66843469cc1dc3562d5e291078a1ca3.gif

It was unclear when the map size would increase, now we have a counter next to the vote box for the remaining tiles until the board gets enlarged.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/2917a992bc026447c43f0439b91565b9f3067d66.gif

We noticed players usually ignore the Star Quests and disasters, to fix that, we also added a star quest progress animation, and for disasters; a noticeable animation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/7cc93433a7d410d3d2457f47c9b1821997e2cab2.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/dc4b7f7099138778f16a3d77a0d2d0ebea8bb163.gif


Bug Fixes

 Fixed problems with some of the building sound effects.
 Fixed an issue causing the troubles to trigger twice when you progress back and forward on the trouble meter.
 Level up bar is now faster, depending on the amount of votes you gained in that term.
 Your current run will not be wiped anymore when you update the game.
 Fixed the lingering bonuses for buildings demolished by Earthquake or Fire.
 Mouse controls are more stable, and on trackpads, map won't shake on building placement.


Balance Updates
Almost all Red Cards now have +1 Day limit on their count-downs.

notes.title: v1.0.7 - Post 1.0 Release Updates 3
notes.content:
As always, thank you for your continuous support, we are also thankful that the reviews about the balance of the game are getting better with our last 2 updates. But we will move things around till it's PERFECT!

We noticed the same issue the community did, that the player agency of the runs is not quite how we want it to be. In order to address this, we made some changes, which will also spice up the early stages of the run, and break the repetitive feel for the early game by creating agency and variety.

- Player now offered 3 cards to choose at the end of Day 1-2-3 (different types) for early game agency
- Game Over condition checks happen at the end of the day instead of instantly
- “Scan and Print” now will get destroyed after playing
- “Smart Solutions” now triggers at Max 5 times (was unlimited)
- Fixed some issues with fonts and UI
- Mayor button tutorial triggers at a better time

Don't hesitate to send us a Steam comment on this post or via bug@stratera.co if you would like to share the bugs, issues, or recommendations you have.

notes.title: v1.0.6 - Post 1.0 release Update 2
notes.content:
Thank you for the amazing support and attention from all the community. We closely follow the community response and made some balance changes & bug fixes.


 We balanced Classic mode to be more starter friendly with extra resources and Officers, and added a new mode called "Expert" which is more challenging and gives more Votes.
 Added "Got It" checkbox on every tutorial screen, which will hide that specific tutorial information panel forever when you check it before pressing Okay.
 We added an animation to make it more clear that -20 resource is a game over condition.
 Game is now more comfortable to play on a wide screen monitor.
 Fixes on missing translations.
 Balances on modes other than Classic.

Don't hesitate to send us a Steam comment on this post or via bug@stratera.co if you would like to share the bugs, issues or recommendations you have.

notes.title: v1.0.5 - Post full release bugfixes
notes.content:
Thank you for the amazing support and attention from all the community. We love your feedback and our first priority on working on this weekend rush was to fix the emerging bugs.


 Fixed a bug causing the music loop to play the same music during a run

notes.title: Cardboard Town 1.0 is here!
notes.content:
Cardboard Town 1.0 is finally here! 

Game Modes, Mega-Projects, New systems and more!
We'll update the game and also launch a 30% Release discount starting August 18th - 20:00 UTC+3 Time

Let's look at our new features before talking about the upcoming updates:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/61bc0a10c5f3dd7cc2bf95ee4603acbfe36332e8.gif

Mega Project Buildings

You can finally win the game! 
There are currently two different "Final Buildings" that we call Mega Projects; complete the Star Quests in a run, obtain the Mega Project cards, build it and win the game!

Mega Projects are linked to Bonus Resources; Education or Industry.
Final building will depend on which resource you've unlocked. If you have both, then you'll obtain a random Mega Project for the end-game.

As we add more Bonus Resources in the future, you'll have more Mega Projects and more end-game conditions!

And don't worry, you can continue your run and gain your Votes after building the Mega Project!
But wait, what are the...


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/2127eec82ee2db28697b981731b2eaba476e173d.gif

Star Quests

Do you have a 3 Star City or a 5 Star one?
Depends on your performance on quests!

You'll get your first Star Quests after Day 10.

Hover your mouse over the stars to learn about your next Star Quest. Some will get done as you progress naturally, some will need extra attention and specific actions. 

With the Star Quests we aim to:

 Provide a path for new or confused players
 Provide bonus challenges and rewards
 Set a prerequisite for the Mega Project cards


If you have any ideas for a Star Quest, send it our way via Twitter or Discord!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/e51e88f32666e053eb4a1862e62a7fb900d1426b.png

Game Modes

They're finally here!! 
After you finish the game, you get to enjoy different modes of Cardboard Town.
They're very new and experimental but some examples;
- A mode where you start with a small map and try to fill it to increase your area.
- A mode where you have a lot of resources and enjoy building your city at your own pace!
- A mode where you get more disasters, only for expert mayors who are looking for a challenge!

We are open to ideas and suggestions for more modes to come, make sure to let us know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/801a9b3fa47093224fc139176597e8fc3847945f.gif

Expanding Board

Need more land?
Whenever your board is almost full, your board will automatically increase by 1 tile. Plan accordingly and ejoy creating huge cities! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/01773443c89a3c1b96ba47eaa584e6cc853d3aad.gif

New Tutorial System
Our previous tutorial system was a little underwhelming, so we've added GIFs and increased the amount of tutorial windows, so you can learn everything you need to become a great mayor!

Already know everything you need to become a great mayor?
Sure about that?
You can close the tutorials in the Settings screen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/307b1b56546f66961fe44011987ed3ba48a09df4.gif

New Buildings and Cards
We don't want to spoil the surprise. Part of the fun in Cardboard Town is exploring all the different buildings, upgrades, action cards and powerful combinations!

For the 1.0 Update; Alongside Mega Project cards, we've added:

 5 New Action Cards
 4 New Buildings
 2 New Quest Buildings
 3 New Upgrades
 3 New Festivals
 4 New Disasters




Future of Cardboard Town

1.0 doesn't mean the end of updates. It means we've reached the "complete experience" we've envisioned but of course we have more ideas and things we want to do, features we want to add.

Some of the "we want to do these" updates:
- New resource & buildings
- Controller Support
- Support for different platforms
- New end-game mega projects
& more!

notes.title: Industry Update: New Cards are Here!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Industry Update!

We have bunch of new cards and new combos to explore in Cardboard Town with the Level 51 resource: Industry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/ffa531c299cc04237a27faff8381b32e3acdfe98.gif

TL;DR:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/2f5a2821326c16cd51b3b82b0a708a4a83d9fd83.jpg

Industry resource unlocks when you build the Furnite Factory quest building.
Industry goes down by 1 at the end of the day, so beware!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/6f7e99e6b3976b7bb17c81c774b88d7534c4c9bd.png
Note: Card texts and balance are outdated and might've changed during testing. 

But here's a fun way of managing the Industry stat:

 Build an oil well and get an Oil Barrel
 Oil Barrels provide industry and electricity when they're destroyed.
 Build a Gas Station to destroy them all for a resourceful combo!

So obviously, industry cards usually hurt the Environment a lot.
And to make room for more industry, you got to destroy buildings and cards!
Burn them all for money and glory!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/b1d03135b055d582aeb7f625eb7ab0a4b533b132.jpg

Enough of that depressive industry talk, here's a furry friend for you to meet and interact!
She likes to do whatever she wants, so she might not be there every time you play, but keep an eye out for her! 
By the way, what should we name her?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/4082d723ee16b9ec452643379a03a700e09c4f4f.gif

See you in Discord or Twitter maybe?

notes.title: QoL Updates & Upcoming Features
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've updated the game with some frequently requested features.
Here's what's up with today's update:

You can now view your deck and discard pile
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/ba7259740ffada08edf40a7cb94c66fbb9be68d1.gif
No more memory-work! Just click on the deck / discard pile to show it's contents.

Disaster Phasing
Some disasters are just annoying while some of them straight out destroys your town if you are unable to handle them. And in early game; sometimes you just can't as a fresh mayor. 

So we've implemented "minimum levels" for disasters. Meaning: Game-ending disasters like Earthquake and Pipe Leak will now occur after City Level 4.

Interested in details? Here's the full list! (Subject to balance)


Minimum Level / Disaster

 4	Disease
 1	Organized Crime
 4	Job Crisis
 1	Drought
 5	Uncontrolled Migration
 1	Luxury Embargo
 1	Short Circuit
 1	Ran Out Of Asphalt
 3	Costly Maintenance
 3	Inflation
 1	Utterly Ruined Plans
 4	Trouble Magnet
 4	Pipe Leak
 4	Thunder Craze
 4	Useless Congress
 1	Bureaucratic Disturbance
 1	Bureaucratic Failure
 4	Earthquake
 1	Cursed
 3	People's Will


Reward Scrolling
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/6539b6338e87c3db1698ed30fbc7ad2517bdee37.gif

You've just completed your run and gained huge amount of levels, because you're awesome! But wait, because you are TOO awesome, rewards just won't fit into your screen...

Well, we've fixed that! Enjoy your rewards.

Note: We know a lot of players want to know what they've unlocked so far (like, all of it) or what will be unlocked later. We're working on a UI to show that information to you in a later date.


Loading Screen
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/b75a8af56278cf352c088252d70e326b984399e4.png

As the game got more chonky, loading is no loner instantenous. So we've added a cute little loading screen so you won't be required to look at the empty table for a couple of seconds.

Starting Hand balance
We've removed "Change of Plans" from the initial hand pool and added one more "House" instead.

This will prevent most of the early game population issues and newbie players won't doom themselves by playing the Plan B card too early.

Upcoming: New Cards!!
After this QoL changes, we want to focus on adding more content.
We'll be working on Inudstry cards.

Industry will be an additional, objective resource just like Education.


Our plans include;

 5  Industry Buildings
 10 Industry Action Cards
 4 Industry Upgrades
 2 Industry Festivals
 1 New Basic Action Card: Destroy an existing building
 1 New Basic Festival
 5 New Meta-Progression Levels


We'll need some time to work on these features and will let you know when we make progress!

Thanks for playing Cardboard Town and all your support!
You can track our progress, give us feedback, or jump into conversation via our linktree.

notes.title: New: Adjacency System!
notes.content:
Upon many requests, we're introducing the adjacency system to Cardboard Town. Basically, people want to live near parks and don't want to leave near factories.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/cc20024342ad7ee8d72d54d2af9a132c7773fa78.png

Certain buildings will have 1 Tile aura that affects population buildings built on those tiles.

There's Green, Red and Teal auras:

 Green Aura: Buildings that produce Environment give +%25 Population bonus.
 Red Aura: Buildings that reduce Environment causes a -%25 Population penalty.
 Teal Aura: Building a population building near a building that produces Safety causes the Trouble-Meter to reduce by 1.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/b1719ab3e39e5dbde9022f7db35aa526c5d4e2e5.png

Auras stack and interact with each other. For example:

 2 Parks built near provides double bonus on their crossing square
 Red and Green auras (Negative and Positive Environement) cancel each other out
 Teal Aura can stack with both auras, not effecting the other


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/68d1bfa588e2026a00d042b165cde208a2ebf49e.png

These auras are only visible when you are in building mode; so don't worry about your cities aesthetics!

We realise this will make the game harder to play but we believe it adds good amount of tactical depth for you to master Cardboard Town! 

Also, while %25 Population bonus is a good amount (which might change during testing btw) you can still play the game succeed without paying much attention to it. So it won't bug our casual players too much, we hope.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/7557673fb0148e02c1beda2c12073b790c843d43.png
A City built with the new system, notice that trees are inside the city to maximize population bonus.

We are currently running the tests with our beta testers and not sure if we'll implement this feature to the demo version yet.

We are planning to explain the mechanic further and let you know about our toughts behing it, so make sure you follow our Twitter and YouTube Channelif you are interested!

What do you think about the adjacency system, would you like to see the system included in Cardboard Town's full version?

Please share your toughts so we can make this system as enjoyable as we can for you.

notes.title: Upcoming Features for Cardboard Town
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

First of all; thank you all so much for your interest in our demo and all the feedback!

We've heard your suggestions and are already working on some of them for the full version.
We're aiming to release the full game sometime in April, make sure you wishlist the game and follow us on Twitter to stay in the loop. 

Now, let's talk about upcoming features:

People in the city 
What's the point of building a city if no one's going to live in it, right?
But who lives in a Cardboard Town? 
That's easy: smol, boardgame people!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/eb2fb35054bef9600ce87b3905e520e2171903c0.png

As your city grows more people will walk (or hop) around the city. We're also increasing the road size to make space for cars! Traffic will not be a part of the management part of game because it sucks and we don't want that. People and cars will be purely for flavor.

The mighty "are you sure" button:
You know what else sucks? Playing a card in an instant, when you didn't mean to do so.
So we're adding a "Play" button as confirmation for all Action Cards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/95bf73c6b40e913f4b30773216f558dc6382dda2.png
No more discarding your whole hand by mistake.

We need more roads!
Is what you've said during the demo. While we believe placing roads tactically and some luck factor is an important part of the game, we want to increase your options to obtain more roads.

So we are adding; Road generating mayor button, more action cards and more upgrades that makes you have more roads!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/6d08733e5920dddab1dc4f1dd83987cc45f41fe6.png
Cheap Asphalt's icon is not ready, Stratera Games logo is a placeholder.

ICYMI: Mayor Button is the (currently red, but actually green) button in the left corner of the screen that makes you draw a card for 4$. You can swap it with different abilities via upgrades.

We've made a poll for the color of the mayor on twitter last week:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/21682daa3045fb4299fd8f7df24b6219c0ef48ca.png

20 New upgrades and more syngergies

You think you've seen what this game has to offer? You're wrong!
We are adding some exciting upgrades for the full version of Cardboard Town and some crazy syngeriges!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/b18fcb3e9e19301023057d26e60a089e5fde8e68.png

Working on Meta Progression
At the end of each run, you will gain points according to your building count, objective buildings completed and population. With those points; your Mayor Level will increase and you'll gain benefits. 

With higher mayor level, you'll be able to build bigger cities.

Here's our current draft for meta progression, please let us know what you think about the level up system!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/9e260be499f7f56c50b61270f684270ce31ff07c.png
Note: this list is work in progress and could change! 

Risky cards:
Finally, we're adding some risky upgrades and action cards for daring players which will be available in the full version.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/50f5197c5fcb1f0d82086baa1652ba625f20dddf.png

Oh by the way, our other game; Verlet Ascend is being released this week! Make sure to check it out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157712/bc0eef6d56bf4351c00be8a8a7e33271e6f6b859.jpg

That's it from us for today.
We'll share another post for specific release date and final upcoming features of our game.
Thank you for reading and please let us know what you think ːsteamhappyː
